_comment: assign_pack precedence: see bake_assets.py. Order matters: earlier packs win for path_prefixes. music (lazy) is listed before shared so audio/music/ files route there even though they share the audio/ prefix. shared (eager) = cross-scene: fonts/, textures/tile_sets/ (atlases), all other audio/ SFX. rooms (lazy, splash-mounted) = 3d/*.glb + offline room bakes. gameplay_bulk (lazy, chain-mounted) = remaining textures/, data/, steam_assets/.
